Ready · Tapziq is your current keyboard

Typed text stays on your device. When you request proofreading, Tapziq briefly hashes up to 2,000 characters of the active field to verify it is unchanged; only the requested passage (up to 500 characters) goes to Android AICore for local Gemini Nano processing. Tapziq does not save that text, read the clipboard, show ads, or run its own analytics. Google ML Kit may use network access for models and send non-content diagnostics and usage metrics. Gemini Nano proofreading is for users 18 and older.
Android shows a standard warning when any downloaded keyboard is enabled. Tapziq cannot enable or select itself; those choices stay under your control.
